metadata.case_name: SHEA LAI CHUEN v. FEDERAL EXPRESS PACIFIC, INC

source: The diagnosis was sprained injury of lumber spine and prolapse of intervertebral disc of lumber spine.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: prolapse of intervertebral disc L5/S1 with compression to right S1 nerve root
source: MIR Examination on 30 January 2003 which revealed L5/S1 disc protrusion with compression to right S1 nerve root.
The diagnosis was sprained injury of lumber spine and prolapse of intervertebral disc of lumber spine.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of sacral spine

manifestations.description: right-sided sciatica / paraesthesia of whole right lower limb
reduced walking tolerance (could walk without rest for one hour only)
inability to perform manual work like car washing and household chores
reduced ability to engage in sports (could not resume swimming, playing golf)
psychological distress and decreased sexual performance and ability

treatments_received: injection treatment to the lumbar disc protrusion and compression to nerve root
treatments_future: laminatomy, removal of protruding disc and decompression of nerve root (recommended)

losses.description: Permanent impairment of the whole person assessed at 15% due to prolapsed intervertebral disc L5/S1 with compression to right S1 nerve root.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Could not do car washing and household chores.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could not resume swimming and playing golf.
Reduced walking and sitting tolerance (could walk without rest for one hour only; sitting tolerance 30 minutes).
Relationship with his wife was less close and could not have outdoor activities with his son and parents.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
